description: This file defines SplashActivity, an Android launcher activity that displays a branded splash screen using the Android 12+ SplashScreen API with fallback support for earlier Android versions. It shows a centered 'Streamly' text and then transitions to MainActivity.

classes.name: SplashActivity
classes.description: Android activity that manages the splash screen shown at app launch.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, installs the splash screen, and transitions to MainActivity.
